objective: Determine the primary mechanism causing a simple synthetic request timeout regression and justify the conclusion using at least two experiment/result cycles.

starting_observations.observation: Requests that exceed 4.9 seconds fail almost exactly at 5.0 seconds, while shorter requests complete normally.
CPU utilization stays below 35%, queue occupancy below 40%, and packet loss below 0.1%.

candidate_hypotheses.statement: A newly lowered client timeout is terminating otherwise healthy requests.
CPU saturation is causing the requests to exceed their deadline.
Network loss is causing retransmissions and deadline failures.

experiment_catalog.intervention: Restore the prior 12-second client timeout while holding load and infrastructure fixed.
Double available CPU while keeping the 5-second timeout unchanged.
Route traffic through a clean alternate network path while keeping the 5-second timeout unchanged.
